concepts.def: Heart and lungs supply O2 to working muscles over prolonged exercise.
Maximum force a muscle or group can exert in one contraction.
Ability of muscles to sustain repeated contractions over time.
Range of motion at a joint, influenced by muscles, tendons and joint structure.
Rate at which a body can move from one point to another; depends on muscle fibres and technique.
Ability to change direction quickly while maintaining control.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Health, Fitness and Well-being — a core area of GCSE PE.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Health, Fitness and Well-being brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Health, Fitness and Well-being.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
